en.headline: Firefighters battle level-three fire at Shek Kwu Chau waste facility
en.dek: A fire broke out at the Integrated Waste Management Facility Phase 1 on an artificial island near Shek Kwu Chau on Monday afternoon, with no injuries reported as crews fought the blaze.
body: Firefighters upgraded a blaze at Hong Kong’s first waste-to-energy facility to a No. 3 alarm after it broke out on Monday afternoon at the Integrated Waste Management Facility Phase 1 on an artificial island near Shek Kwu Chau.

Police received a report from staff at about 12:43 pm. Fire Services arrived and raised the alarm to No. 3 at 1:24 pm, deploying two hose lines and two breathing apparatus teams. Four ambulances stood by at the scene. No injuries have been reported.

The Fire Services Department said members of the public affected by drifting smoke or odour should close windows and remain calm. The facility, known as I·PARK1, is designed to process municipal solid waste and generate electricity.

zh.headline: 石鼓洲焚化設施三級火 消防灌救暫無傷亡
zh.dek: 周一中午石鼓洲附近人工島上的綜合廢物管理設施第一期發生火警，消防升為三級，暫未接獲受傷報告。
body: 石鼓洲旁人工島的綜合廢物管理設施第一期周一中午發生火警，消防處將火警升為三級，現場暫未接獲傷亡報告。
警方約下午12時43分接獲職員報案，消防人員到場後於下午1時24分將火警升為三級，動用兩條喉及兩隊煙帽隊灌救，並派出四輛救護車戒備。
消防處表示，如市民受到隨風飄散的煙霧和異味影響，請關閉門窗及保持鎮定。涉事設施為I·PARK1，是本港首座轉廢為能的廢物處理設施。
